metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code plugins: guarded slice workflow, interview-driven docs, eval discipline, advisor agents, and a UK pharma compliance domain pack

plugins.name: sp
plugins.description: Guarded slice workflow: /sp:refine → /sp:start → /sp:implement → /sp:commit → /sp:push → /sp:done. TDD, atomic commits, worktree-per-slice, each step guards the previous one.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Interview-driven living-document workflow — builds a PRD (or any contested doc) section by section, interrogating old claims against evidence instead of merging them unreviewed.

plugins.name: evalcraft
plugins.description: Inspect-AI eval discipline: scorer refinement skill (deterministic-first, escalation judges), report fact-check skill, and a skeptical eval-methodology reviewer agent.

plugins.name: sitecheck
plugins.description: Deterministic AI-crawler-visibility audit for a website: robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap size and growth cadence, live crawler-access test, and a Wayback Machine cross-check against self-reported growth claims.
